text: Figure 8.3: Modeling of process states The supported process states that are defined in the Process.processStateMachine are described in more detail in [10]. It is possible to define a so-called execution dependency, such that one Process can only launch if a referenced other Process is in a given process state. The details are explained in section 8.3.5.
